seo.title: AI agent skills: booking, tickets, leads and handoff | Steps AI
seo.description: Give your AI agent skills to book appointments, create tickets, save leads, hand over to your team and search the web, with rules you write in plain English.

hero.title: Give your agent skills that finish the job.
hero.body: Skills let your agent do more than answer. It can book an appointment, create a ticket, save a lead or hand the conversation to your team, following rules you write in plain English.
hero.reassurance: Ready-made skills. Rules in plain English. Custom skills when you need them.

steps.title: How a skill works.
steps.intro: Every skill has the same simple parts.

items.title: Say when to use it
items.body: Describe in plain English when the skill should be used, with examples of when it should and should not.

items.title: Choose what it collects
items.body: Pick the details to ask for, such as name, email, phone or a photo.

items.title: Connect the app it needs
items.body: Some skills use an app, such as a calendar for bookings. Others need nothing extra.

items.title: Decide what happens next
items.body: Save the details to your CRM, notify your team or send them on to another tool.

features.title: Skills you can switch on.
features.intro: Start with the ready-made skills and add your own.

items.title: Book appointments
items.body: Book into Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, Calendly, Cal.com or Square Appointments.

items.title: Create tickets
items.body: Turn problems into tickets with the fields you require, and email the right people.

items.title: Save customers and leads
items.body: Create a customer record from the conversation in your CRM or HubSpot.

items.title: Hand over to a person
items.body: Set a wait time, a fallback message and who gets an email when a customer needs your team.

items.title: Search the web
items.body: Optional. The agent checks your own information first and searches the web only when that does not cover it.

items.title: Calculate shipment landed cost
items.body: For importers and sourcing agents, estimate freight, insurance and commission.

items.title: Build custom skills
items.body: Create AI skills with your own instructions, or flow skills that collect details and call an app or a webhook.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Each booking skill uses one calendar provider. You can connect several and choose per skill.
Clear rules for when not to use a skill help the agent avoid using it by mistake.

items.q: Do I need to write code?
items.a: No. You describe when to use a skill in plain English and choose options from menus.

items.q: Can a skill send data to my own tools?
items.a: Yes. A skill can follow up with a webhook, an HTTP request or an action in a connected app.

items.q: How does the agent decide to use a skill?
items.a: It matches the customer’s intent to the rules and examples you write for each skill.

items.label: Workflow builder
items.body: Run follow-ups after a skill has been used.

items.label: Integrations
items.body: Connect the calendars and apps your skills use.

items.label: CRM
items.body: See the records and tickets skills create.
